messages:
elaine (sales_eng): Kickoff — AcroBank POC. They want streaming SDK with function/tool calls + structured JSON output. Legal asked for SSO + data residency in eu-west-1. CISO flagged token rotation and no-PII logging. Also pricing question: they want estimate for 100rps sustained with burst to 1k. Can engs help with a minimal Go and Python SDK snippet we can hand them?

mike (solutions_eng): +1. I can draft snippets. For streaming + function calls we recommend using the SDK streaming client with toolbinding param. Will share sample.

sarah (security_lead): CISO items: need SOC2 cert copy, IP allowlist options, ephemeral creds for the POC, and clarity on what metadata is logged (no raw inputs). We also need KMS integration details.

dan (devex): I have a small Go example that mounts a func handler and uses structured schema output. Example will be <= 12 lines. Also add curl + websocket minimal debug flow.

alex (eng_infra): For 100 rps sustained we suggest Dedicated reserved with autoscale headroom. Ballpark pricing: reserved tier + burst credits — I'll DM numbers but expect monthly commit. Real cost depends on model choice + quantization.

mike (solutions_eng): For token rotation: recommend STS ephemeral tokens per session. We have occ logs showing we do not persist request bodies in plain text; only traces/ids. Sarah confirm this?

sarah (security_lead): Correct. We store hashed traces and truncated metadata. We can provide an exportable redaction policy and a KMS integration doc. Need client to sign DPA for EU residency.

elaine (sales_eng): Can someone drop the Go/Python snippets and a short checklist of security docs we can hand them by EOD? AcroBank wants a POC sign-off next Tues.

dan (devex): Dropping snippets here in thread in a sec. Also adding a minimal structured-output schema and a test prompt set for regression checks.

mike (solutions_eng): Also flagging a blocker: Legal wants an answer on on-prem/private deployment for certain flows. If on-prem required, that'll be a separate Private engagement and timeline.

elaine (sales_eng): Noted. I'll escalate on pricing + private path. Thanks everyone :pray: 

security-bot: Document upload: SOC2_report_Q3.pdf (access restricted).

alex (eng_infra): Uploaded dedicated pricing sheet to the deal folder and pinged finance for an accelerated quote.

elaine (sales_eng): Great — I'll consolidate into a single deck for AcroBank. If anyone has test credentials for ephemeral tokens, DM me. Thanks!
